profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with its site at khoslaventures.com. The company describes itself as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence.

Its site also describes backing a broad, category-defining finance workflow platform that leverages proprietary data and AI talent. It carries commentary that autonomous driving in closed systems is now easy to do and deploy, which it says should raise questions about new infrastructure projects involving old-school high speed rail. On economics, the site argues that AI will transform economies and require a rethink of capitalism and equity, that the labor portion of the economy will decline sharply relative to capital, and that eliminating preferential capital gains treatment after 2028 and taxing it as ordinary income could generate approximately $400B per year.

No products are tracked for the company, no MCP servers are listed, and no lawsuits are listed. Its legal exposure is listed for California, with a count of 264.
